---
title: Install
---

## From a GitHub release (side-load)

1. Open the [latest release](https://github.com/progressive-kiwi/open-garmin-watchface/releases/latest)
   and download `OpenFace-prg.zip`.
2. Unzip it and pick `OpenFace-<device>.prg` for your watch (device ids are listed below).
3. Connect the watch over USB. Copy the file into `GARMIN/APPS/` on the watch
   (on macOS use [OpenMTP](https://openmtp.ganeshrvel.com/) or Android File Transfer).
4. Disconnect. On the watch, hold the menu button on the watch face, choose **Watch Face**, and select **Open Face**.

Side-loaded apps cannot be configured from the Garmin Connect phone app. Use the on-watch settings
(**Watch Face** → **Open Face** → **Customize**) instead; every setting is there.

## Store package

`OpenFace.iq` in each release is the store package for the Connect IQ Store upload flow.

## Configure

- **Garmin Connect app** (store installs): *Device → Watch Faces → Open Face → Settings*.
- **On the watch**: hold the menu button on the face → **Watch Face** → **Open Face** → **Customize**.
  Settings are grouped like the [settings reference](settings.qmd): General, Analog, Dial, Digital, Data, Always-on, Night.
